title: Earliest time a flooded grid can be crossed
insight: LeetCode 778 Swim in Rising Water: minimax path, i.e. Dijkstra with a heap keyed by the highest elevation seen so far (or binary search on t with a BFS), O(RC log RC)
prompt: For the flood-planning tool, please implement EarliestCrossing in crossing.go. README.md is the contract, including the 500 x 500 grids it has to handle quickly. Leave the package name and the exported signature as they are, rely only on the standard library, and verify that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass before you report back.
